title: p2y5.3: Rust gateway: RPL DODAG root — DIO advertisement, DAO acceptance, routing table
description: Gateway must act as RPL DODAG root: advertise prefix via DIO, accept DAOs from mesh nodes, build/maintain the routing table. RPL root config flag exists but the full DODAG root lifecycle (periodic DIO, DAO processing, route installation) is not wired. Rust RPL crate has the primitives; this wires them into the gateway main loop.
